{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|WARNING!<br />''"''Listed Recipient Only! This Diplomatic Pouch Is Actively Enabled: Without Positive Identification Contents Will Plasmate on Packet Rupture!|A Troxan incendiary packet addressed to Jedi Master Yoda|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
An '''incendiary packet''' was a parcel that, if opened by anyone other than the addressee, would self-immolate. An incendiary packet used distinctive biomarkers to determine whether the person attempting to open it was the intended recipient. These signs included [[Eye/Legends|retinal]] scans, [[Limb/Legends|fingerprints]], gill patterns, and facial recognition. The [[Troxan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] used incendiary packets during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="YDR" />
